source: FAA Advisory 107 sets the O'Hare stop period at 2010Z–2130Z with reason EQUIPMENT / OUTAGE and comment COMMS ISSUES; IFR Meter logs the same restriction. FAA Advisory 111, issued 2054Z, orders all airports ground stopped until further notice. WBEZ reports the same order. [Advisory 111](https://www.fly.faa.gov/ois/oisedit/adv_oisedit_dis?day=11132026&number=111) · [WBEZ](https://www.wbez.org/transportation/2026/11/13/all-departing-flights-grounded-nationwide-due-to-faa-order)

WBEZ quotes Secretary Duffy saying a communication issue affected all 22 air traffic control centers that route planes between airports. [WBEZ](https://www.wbez.org/transportation/2026/11/13/all-departing-flights-grounded-nationwide-due-to-faa-order)

Official statements call it a telecommunications or communications issue but do not name the failed system or carrier. CBS, citing multiple sources, reports that an update to the private ATC network caused a reboot; that is sourced reporting, not official confirmation.
